title: Super fun and easy to set up and use!
text: Super fun and easy to set up and use!. This is a cute gadget for the person who has everything! Easy to add batteries and easy to use, this would make a great gift during the holidays. No more messing around with manual screwing bottle openers, this makes opening a wine bottle super easy. I have some fingers which are arthritic and this opener makes the chore a simple pleasure. I highly recommend this opener for everyone!

product_metadata.title: Electric Wine Opener, Automatic Electric Wine Bottle Corkscrew Opener, Cordless Electric Corkscrew Wine Cork Remover, Easy to use with USB Charging (Stainless Steel) (Black)
features: 【Easy to Use】 Remove seal with foil cutter included. With simple push button operation, electric wine opener removes the cork effortlessly in seconds; the cork is no longer damaged. Enjoy wine easily with your family.

【Rechargeable】Built in rechargeable lithium battery, electric wine opener can remove cork in 6 seconds and charge quickly in 2.5 hours. A full charge can open up to 70 bottles. Environmentally friendly, more efficiently. DC input is 100-240V.

【Portable Electric Wine Bottle Opener 】With attractive red matte finish and transparent visible shell around corkscrew mechanism, you can see the whole cork removal process, electric corkscrew opener is sleek and lightweight. You can charge it with USB cord in multi-ways and easy to carry it everywhere.

【Perfect Gift 】The automatic wine opener is a brilliant gift idea for wine lovers at Birthday, Wedding, Anniversary, Graduation, New Year’s Day, Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, Father’s Day, Halloween, Thanks Giving, Christmas, etc. .
【Warranty】 We offer 12 months warranty and lifetime friendly customer service. If you have any questions about our product, we will arrange fully refund or replace item.
